steps.finding: 2 stock lines across 2 hospitals, 2 presentations, in units of use.

steps.purpose: Read Corvale General's approved interchanges for these items.

steps.title: Which links can't be trusted
steps.purpose: Run the semantic layer's key rules (NDC and unit of use) over each hospital's stock, and name the rows they reject.
steps.finding: 11 stock rows across the system fail the NDC rule; 1 of them are this drug. Every row is in a shared unit of use.

steps.title: What we decided last time
steps.purpose: Recall past decisions on this drug from H-MEM, with who approved them.
steps.finding: No past decisions on this drug.

explanation.headline: Oxacillin sodium is not on FDA's shortage list as of 2026-10-21; current supply at Corvale General is 25.6 days on hand

sentences.text: FDA's drug shortage list does not include oxacillin sodium as of 2026-10-21.
Corvale General holds 389 vials of the 1 g injection, which at a use rate of 15.2 vials per day provides 25.6 days on hand.
The rule‑based check finds no FDA shortage posting before an action at a registered plant, so the state is classified as check.
The top ranked purchasing option is to buy from Armas Pharmaceuticals Inc., which is also not on FDA's shortage list today.
Armas Pharmaceuticals Inc. is supplied by ONESOURCE SPECIALTY PHARMA LIMITED - Beta Lactam Division, whose last inspection was VAI on 2019-02-14.
An alternate manufacturer is Onesource Specialty Pharma Limited, supplied by the same plant with a VAI inspection on 2019-02-14.
A third option is Baxter Healthcare Corporation, whose label names no plant that could be placed.
